questions.q: Which hormone is NOT released during flow?
questions.why: The book lists dopamine, norepinephrine, and five others, but not serotonin.

questions.q: What brain region shuts down briefly in flow?
questions.why: The text explains transient hypofrontality involves the prefrontal cortex.

questions.q: Which effect describes how one achievement changes perception?
questions.why: The book refers to the Roger Bannister effect for changing what seems possible.

questions.q: What is the main benefit of flow mentioned?
questions.why: Flow is described as a high that supercharges performance and focus.

questions.q: Which hormone helps filter important information in flow?
questions.why: Dopamine is said to filter noise and sharpen focus during flow.
